title: Rune of the Wolf

sources.title: Rune of the Wolf
markers: {{story|Rune of the Wolf}} is a [[Story Item]]. It is used in the Empty Socket to open the [[Hidden Vault]], in the [[Enclave Library]].

sources.title: Inner Sanctum
markers: activated together with the three other runes

summary: Opens the Hidden Vault in the Emerald Grove.

fields.Access: Place the rune in the Empty Socket of the Enclave Library and activate the rune pedestals to open the Hidden Vault.
fields.Acquisition: Speak with Rath after saving the first druid, or pickpocket or loot him.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
